selection.weightsMeaning: Product hypotheses based on user preference, not usage statistics; renormalize after eligibility and brief filters
selection.weightScope: Primary album family, not independent random style on every page
selection.capacity: photoCount refers to distinct photos required for this variant
selection.coverage: Every selected photo must appear; never silently discard or duplicate to fill a grid
selection.caption: Optional user supplied text only; absent text leaves whitespace
selection.density: Evaluate outer whitespace separately from photos per page
selection.crop: Reject unsafe subject crops even when a template is otherwise preferred
selection.anotherOption: Automatic selection excludes the three most recent families. Explicit family selection varies geometry within that family. Coverage and crop safety take precedence.
selection.integrationBoundary: After PhotoImportController brief and analysis; no additional file event handlers
